name: anti-doom-scroll
description: A powerful browser extension that helps you break free from endless social media scrolling by blocking scroll functionality when viewing individual posts, while still allowing you to browse freely.

scripts.build:chrome: tsc && TARGET_BROWSER=chrome BUILD_DIR=dist-chrome vite build && cp -r src/icons dist-chrome/src/
scripts.build:firefox: tsc && TARGET_BROWSER=firefox BUILD_DIR=dist-firefox vite build && cp -r src/icons dist-firefox/src/
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
